name: Marginalia
author: Sajjad Heydari
description: A hidden context menu on cards, verbs, aspects and the board: notes, board labels, rulers, a board list, a recipe explorer, finding cards, a timers panel, pausing when a verb finishes or a card is about to decay, and the wiki in game. Middle-click to open it.
description_long:
This mod uses AI generated code.

A hidden context menu for Cultist Simulator, on cards, verbs, aspects, open windows and the bare table.

[b]Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2901287611]GHIRBI[/url][/b], because this is a DLL mod. Restart the game after enabling it.

[h2]Opening the menu[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Middle-click[/b] a card, verb, aspect icon, open window or the table. The game doesn't see that click.
[*]Or rest the pointer on a card or verb: a small round [b]…[/b] button appears in its top-left corner. Click it.
[*]Or [b]double-click[/b] an aspect icon.
[*]Or hold [b]Alt[/b] and [b]right-click[/b], as before.
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Write a persistent note on any card, verb or aspect. Notes are shared across all your saves.
[*]The menu previews the note. Enter starts a new line, Ctrl+Enter keeps it, Esc discards it.
[/list]

[h2]Pausing[/h2]
[list]
[*]On a verb, pick [i]Pause at every step…[/i] to pause each time its timer runs out, or [i]Pause at the end[/i] to pause only when its results are waiting.
[*]On a card that decays, pick [i]Pause before it decays…[/i]. It applies to every card of that kind.
[*]A slider sets how long before the timer runs out to pause, from right after it ends up to 185 seconds before, in fine steps near zero.
[*]On any card, pick [i]Pause when one appears[/i] to pause every time a new card of that kind turns up, on the table or in a verb.
[*]The pause lands on the exact moment at any game speed, and a gold ring pulses around whatever caused it.
[*][i]Step time 0.1 s forward[/i] on the board menu moves a paused game on by a tenth of a second.
[/list]

[h2]Finding things[/h2]
[list]
[*][i]Find on the table…[/i] on the board menu: as you type, a gold ring goes around every card and verb whose name matches. A card inside a closed verb rings the verb.
[*][i]Show timers[/i] opens a small panel of every running verb and decaying card, soonest first. Click a row to ring it.
[/list]

[h2]Board labels[/h2]
[list]
[*]Open the menu on the table and pick [i]Write on the board…[/i]. The text sits under the cards and pans and zooms with the table.
[*]Open the menu on a label to edit, resize or rub it out. Middle-drag (or Alt + left-drag) to move it, even past the table's edge.
[*]A label of several lines has an arrow in its corner: click it to fold the label to its first line, and again to open it out.
[*]Pick a background from the label's menu: dark panel, outline, transparent or parchment.
[/list]

[h2]Rulers[/h2]
[list]
[*]Open the menu on the table and pick [i]Add grid…[/i], [i]Add line (H)…[/i] or [i]Add line (V)…[/i]. Sliders set the size in cards.
[*]Grids are card-sized cells; lines are ticked every card width or height. Rulers snap so their cells line up with where the game snaps cards.
[*]They never move or sort your cards. They're only guides for laying things out by hand.
[*]Open the menu on a ruler to resize or remove it. Middle-drag (or Alt + left-drag) to move it.
[/list]

[h2]Recipe explorer[/h2]
[list]
[*][i]Recipe explorer…[/i] on the board menu opens a floating panel with every recipe in the game, read from the game's own data, so DLCs and content mods are included. Drag it by its title and resize it by its corner; the board stays in play.
[*]Each recipe shows its verb, then what it needs and gives as card and aspect icons. Hover an icon for its name; click it for what makes it and what uses it. Needs are shown as the cards that go in the verb: the main card, then each slot it opens.
[*]Search by name, card or aspect. [i]startable[/i] hides recipes that only follow another; [i]discovered[/i] shows only the recipes you've finished, kept across saves.
[*]Star recipes, cards and aspects as favourites, hide recipes you don't want listed ([i]show hidden[/i] at the bottom lists them again), and open the wiki or write a note from any row.
[*]With The Roost Machine, recipe effects and xtriggers are read from where Roost keeps them.
[/list]

[h2]Board list[/h2]
[list]
[*][i]Board list…[/i] on the board menu lists every label, grid and line on the table: go to one, bring it to the middle of the view, edit it or delete it, or select several to bring or delete at once.
[*]Anything entirely off the table is marked, so you can bring it back or delete it. Dragging a ruler stops at the table's edge.
[/list]

[h2]Wiki[/h2]
[list]
[*][i]Open wiki[/i] shows the item's Cultist Simulator Wiki article in an in-game window, with working links and a Back button. [i]Browser[/i] opens it in the Steam overlay. Needs an internet connection.
[/list]

[h2]Details[/h2]
Notes, labels, rulers, pauses, discovered recipes, favourites and hidden recipes are stored in marginalia.json, marginalia_board.json, marginalia_rulers.json, marginalia_pauses.json, marginalia_discovered.json, marginalia_favourites.json and marginalia_hidden.json next to your save files. On Steam they also sync through Steam Cloud, so they follow you between computers. Where the panels sit stays on each computer, in marginalia_local.json.

Settings go in config.ini in the save folder, one per line: marginalia_button=forward (or back, or none) changes the button that opens the menu; marginalia_handle=off hides the … button; marginalia_modifier=ctrl (or shift) changes the key used with right-click. Some Linux window managers grab Alt + right-drag; try ctrl if that menu never appears.

Unofficial fan mod, not affiliated with Weather Factory or Fandom. Source: [url=https://github.com/MCSH/cultist-simulator-marginalia]github.com/MCSH/cultist-simulator-marginalia[/url]
